newsitem.title: CHINA: China FDI seen at $43 billion for 1997, up 3.0 pct.
newsitem.headline: China FDI seen at $43 billion for 1997, up 3.0 pct.

text.p: China's foreign direct investment (FDI) was expected to grow about 3.0 percent to $43 billion this year, edging up from last year's record $42.35 billion, the Financial News said on Sunday.
FDI fell 1.4 percent year-on-year at the end of May because of the high base rate and because China was placing greater emphasis on the quality of investment rather than quantity, the newspaper said.
A number of large contracts were expected to be completed in the second half, halting the decline in FDI, it said. It gave no details.

Actual foreign investment totalled $26.014 billion in the first seven months, up by 15.75 percent compared with the year-ago period, while contracted foreign investment totalled $27.871 billion in the first seven months, plunging 42.82 percent from a year ago, official figures show.
